The automatic evaluation metrics for polarity calibration are the root mean squared error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) between polarity scores of output summary and input text. The human evaluation aims to assess the generated summaries from three perspectives: polarity bias, content semantics, and language quality. Specifically, we provide the human annotators with input text and model generated summaries, and ask them five questions regarding polarity bias, content nonhallucination, content non-redundancy, language fluency, and language coherency (Appendix C). Four human annotators who are specialized in natural language processing participated in the evaluation.
